Donald Trump has won the Texas contest, NBC News projects, and secured the state’s 40 Electoral College votes.
The conservative state voted to back Trump in the last two elections.
In 2020, Trump won Texas with 52% of the vote, while Joe Biden received 47%.
In 2016, Trump won Texas with 53% of the vote, while Hillary Clinton received 43%.
Texas has remained a safely red state since the 1980 presidential election, though there are some signs of a political shift due to changing demographics as well as other factors.

The expected vote is the total number of votes that are expected in a given race once all votes are counted.

This number is an estimate and is based on several different factors, including information on the number of votes cast early as well as information provided to our vote reporters on Election Day from county election officials.
